OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

DOPPEL_API_BASE_URL.description: Doppel API base URL. A trailing /v1 or /v2 is accepted and normalized to the selected api_version.

DOPPEL_API_VERSION.description: Doppel API version. Choose exactly one authentication mode: V1 API keys or V2 OAuth client credentials.

DOPPEL_API_KEY.description: V1 API key sent as the x-api-key header. Required for V1 and must be unset for V2.

DOPPEL_USER_API_KEY.description: Optional V1 user API key sent as the x-user-api-key header. Must be unset for V2.

DOPPEL_ORGANIZATION_CODE.description: Optional V1 organization workspace code sent as the x-organization-code header. Must be unset for V2.

DOPPEL_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID required for V2 and must be unset for V1.

DOPPEL_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret required for V2 and must be unset for V1.

DOPPEL_TOKEN_URL.description: Optional V2 OAuth token endpoint. Defaults to /oauth/token on the API base URL and must be unset for V1.

DOPPEL_TOKEN_AUDIENCE.description: OAuth audience used only for the V2 client-credentials exchange.

DOPPEL_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP level of the imported entities.

DOPPEL_ALERTS_ENDPOINT.description: API resource path for alert ingestion. A leading v1/ or v2/ is accepted and normalized to api_version.

DOPPEL_HISTORICAL_POLLING_DAYS.description: Determines the time-window for initial data fetching

DOPPEL_MAX_RETRIES.description: Configures automated error recovery from transient failures

DOPPEL_RETRY_DELAY.description: Controls the frequency of requests during error recovery

DOPPEL_PAGE_SIZE.description: Optimizes request volume and memory usage per fetch

DOPPEL_ENABLE_RFT_CASE.description: Enables creation of RFT cases for takedown alerts
